A literal line ending inside a code span folds to a space, per CommonMark

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>see <code>a\nb</code> here</p>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
